forearm_verticality.description: Angle between forearm and vertical axis during preparatory phase

elbow_flexion_preparatory.description: Elbow flexion angle during preparatory phase

elbow_flexion_release.description: Elbow extension angle at ball release

elbow_height.description: Elbow height relative to head (absolute for adults)

knee_flexion.description: Knee flexion angle during crouch phase

hip_flexion.description: Hip flexion angle - maintain alignment, avoid excessive forward lean

shoulder_angle.description: Shoulder angle (arm elevation) for free-throw shooting

release_angle_2.8m.description: Ball release angle for shots at 2.8m distance

release_angle_4.6m.description: Ball release angle for shots at 4.6m distance

release_angle_6.0m_plus.description: Ball release angle for shots at 6.0m+ distance

entry_angle.description: Ball entry angle at rim - steeper entry increases scoring chance

wrist_angular_velocity.description: Peak wrist angular velocity post-release - indicates good wrist flick

grip_quality.description: Grip quality score based on finger spread and palm contact (0-1)

release_height.description: Ball release height relative to ground (for adult males)

arc_height.description: Maximum height of ball trajectory relative to rim (approx 3.05m)

follow_through_duration.description: Duration wrist remains extended after release - indicates discipline
